caption: Qualitative evaluation of encoders' codebook. We visualize the number of CIFAR-10 test data points per class assigned to each centroid during training. We assign a data point to the centroid with the smallest statistical distance from its encoder. Each centroid progressively attracts data points of the same class. Moreover, all centroids are assigned a non-zero number of test datapoints. Therefore, the centroids are useful for better explaining both train and previously unseen, test data points.
